terms.gloss: a paved or beaten floor; paving
terms.comment: A hard floor of stones or tiles, indoors or out, not specially the footway beside a road.

phrases.latin: In crepīdine manē; hīc multa vehicula praetereunt.
phrases.english: Stay on the pavement; lots of cars go by here.

sources: Lewis & Short: crepido · Lewis & Short: pavimentum
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 357, 379.
